messages:
Sophia: Quick heads-up — vendor sent updated leadtimes for the mixed H100/H200 order. H100 replacements: 6-8 weeks, on-site repairs ~10 days. H200 availability looks stable at 2-3 weeks but only ~120 units left for Q3. We also have 12 active DOAs pending RMA labels. @Mike @Chen can we decide routing?
Mike: Ugh. Can we divert some of the H200s to APAC edge to cover the 8 failing nodes there? Those H100s are better for heavy batch jobs but APAC needs steady capacity.
Chen: If we divert H200s to APAC we risk backfilling our EU dedicated pool. How many H100s can the vendor expedite?
Eva (Vendor): We can air-expedite up to 10 H100 units from the next shipment, shipping in 72-96 hours after PO and expedite fee confirmation. Standard replacement shipments remain on 6-8w schedule. Repairs still ~10 business days from depot.
Liam: @Eva what's the expedite fee per unit and any customs/doc lift we should expect for EU/APAC?
Eva (Vendor): Expedite premium is +$1,250/unit (includes expedited freight & pickup). For EU shipments we'll need HS codes on the PO (HS 8471.80), and a proforma listing serials for customs. APAC shipments may need temporary import bond depending on country — adds variable fees.
Mike: OK we'll model cost. @finance-bot can you run a quick delta calc for expedite vs capacity shortfall penalty?
finance-bot: Quick calc done: expedite 10 units = $12,500 freight premium + est customs/broker $1,200 = $13,700. Estimated revenue impact of 5% app degradation for APAC region = ~$28k/week. Recommendation: approve expedite for 6 units to cover critical nodes.
Chen: Sounds reasonable to me. Which serials are eligible for immediate swap? We need a manifest to hand to depots. Also open question: can we consolidate RMAs to a single AWB to save broker fees?
Eva (Vendor): We need the serials pre-validated. If you send a CSV with serial, node-id, and depot code we can pre-authorize RMAs and consolidate into up to 2 AWBs for expedite shipments. For warranty returns we provide prepaid labels — but customs returns from APAC/EU sometimes require local broker clearance; that won't be covered by warranty labels.
Sophia: Plan: 1) Approve expedite for 6 H100 units 2) Send CSV manifest by EOD with the failing serials and depot codes 3) Vendor consolidates into 2 AWBs and issues proforma. @Mike can your oncall ops run export of serials and node mapping and drop CSV in the shared drive?
Mike: On it. Will run `kubectl drain` + annotate node, then pull `inventory export --failed-nodes --format=csv`. I'll push file to //shared/supplies/RMA-manifests.csv once done.
Chen: Also note: we should set a temporary routing policy to send batch jobs to dedicated pools while nodes are in transit. I'll open a short-lived routing rule and a canary to monitor latency.
ops-bot: Incident created: RMA-routing-2026-179246 — priority: medium. Assigned: @Mike, @Chen.
Liam: One last ask — can vendor include batch-of-serial photos for customs and returns? Helps speed depot acceptance.
Eva (Vendor): Yes, we can attach photos and initial QC notes to the manifest. Need confirmation on format (single ZIP with JPEGs named by serial or a single PDF).
Sophia: ZIP named by serial is easiest. Thanks all — once PO + CSV are in, we push the expedite. We'll revisit if more RMAs pop up. :thumbsup:
